mapper.sql: id, session_id, sender_type, sender_id, content, message_seq, satisfaction, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (session_id, sender_type, sender_id, content, message_seq) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{senderType}, #{senderId}, #{content}, #{messageSeq})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY message_seq ASC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(message_seq), 0) FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}

SELECT AVG(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, transfer_time, first_agent_msg))) FROM ( SELECT a.session_id, (SELECT MIN(create_time) FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = a.session_id AND sender_type = 'SYSTEM') AS transfer_time, a.first_agent_msg FROM ( SELECT session_id, MIN(create_time) AS first_agent_msg FROM chat_messages WHERE sender_type = 'AGENT' AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY session_id ) a ) t WHERE t.transfer_time IS NOT NULL

SELECT satisfaction AS satisfactionLevel, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS totalCount FROM chat_messages WHERE sender_type = 'AGENT' AND sender_id = #{agentId} AND satisfaction IS NOT NULL AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY satisfaction ORDER BY satisfaction DESC
SELECT AVG(satisfaction) FROM chat_messages WHERE sender_type = 'AGENT' AND satisfaction IS NOT NULL AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT sender_id AS agentId, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessionCount FROM chat_messages WHERE sender_type = 'AGENT' AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY sender_id ORDER BY sessionCount DESC
